pr_title: modem: pipe: add missing timeout parameters
pr_body:
Add the missing timeout parameter to `modem_pipe_open()` and `modem_pipe_close()` calls.
10 seconds is the default value used in the Zephyr tree.

Fixes a regression introduced in https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/74325.

Fixes: #76456
pr_comments: I think it is better to refer to commits (in commit messages) using "first 12 characters of the SHA-1 ID, and the one line summary" rather than the pull request link.

Built the failing tests locally and things seem fine, run also a full CLANG build for native_sim.
Merged bypassing CI to speed up things as too many PRs are failing due to this.

Author: Bjarki Arge Andreasen <bjarki@arge-andreasen.me>
Date:   Mon Jun 10 17:51:15 2024 +0200

    modem: pipe: Add explicit timeout to sync APIs

    The modem pipe APIs include synchronous calls to open/close,
    which internally use a fixed timeout of 10 seconds. The timeout
    should be configurable through the APIs, anywhere from K_NO_WAIT
    to K_FOREVER.

    This commit adds timeout parameters to the open/close APIs, and
    updates in-tree usage of the open/close APIs to explicitly
    provide the previously implicit timeout of 10 seconds.
